summary_1line: Bhishma affirms the Pandavas fulfilled exile terms, urges strategic defense against Arjuna, and the Kauravas arrange their army for the coming battle.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma, white-haired and armored, stands before the Kaurava chiefs explaining the turning wheel of time while warriors listen beneath fluttering battle banners.
The Kaurava army forms ranks across the field as Bhishma assigns Drona to the center, Kripa and Aswatthaman to the wings, and Karna to the van.
In the distance Arjuna's chariot thunders forward, the Gandiva bow twanging as his banner rises above the battlefield and the Kaurava warriors watch tensely.
